lines.latin: al-Fadl lil-'Uturat wa-Adawat at-Tajmil (Al Fadl Perfumes and Cosmetics)

notes: Painted wooden fascia over two closed shop doors, Souq Waqif, Doha. Spelling PERFUMS is as written; the final L of FAZAL has a chipped foot. Small 'فرع' (branch) and 'ذ.م.م' marks and the bottom line of registration/phone numbers in Arabic-Indic digits (س.ت / ١٦٣٨٤ ص.ب / ٢٩٨٩ ...) are not transcribed. A small shop-number plate '380' on the right door is a secondary address cue.

Taken through a windscreen.
